meta.description: Movers from Boston to New York with a flat-rate quote, our own crews and our own truck from pickup to delivery. Packing and storage available. Free quote.

hero.h1: Movers From Boston to New York
overview: Moving from Boston to New York is a long distance move, so Better Life Moving quotes it at a flat rate. Our crew packs and loads in Boston, and our truck carries everything to your new address.
hero.ctaLabel: Get a Boston to New York Quote

intro: Most people making this move are going from one apartment to another, often with an elevator booking or a narrow stairwell at one end or both. Send us those details with your date and both addresses, and a manager prices the move before anything is booked.

sections.h2: How a Boston to New York Move Is Priced
body: Long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate. The figure comes from your move date, the size of your home and both addresses, and a manager explains the booking terms, including any deposit, when they go over it with you.
Packing and storage can go on the same quote. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, which helps when your New York lease starts a week or two after the Boston one ends.

sections.h2: One Carrier From Boston to Your New York Door
body: Better Life Moving is a carrier, not a broker. We hold interstate operating authority under USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489, and the crew that loads your things in Boston works for the same company that delivers them in New York.
That matters on a route this busy, where many moves are sold by one company and carried by another you've never heard of.

sections.h2: What to Send Us for a New York Move
body: Building rules at both ends decide a lot about the day. Tell us the elevator reservation windows, any certificate or loading requirements your New York building has, and how far the truck can park from the door.
list: Your move date and how flexible it is
The size of your Boston home and anything unusually large
Both addresses, with floor numbers and elevator details
Whether you want packing, storage or both
